'''Maralenda''' is an [[Andoran]] [[Aes Sedai]] of noble origin, in the rebel camp near [[Tar Valon]]{{ref/book|12|8}}. Therefore, she is not of the [[Red Ajah]]. 

She is a distant cousin to the House [[Trakand]] and [[Siuan]] uses the fact that she had been seen talking to [[Romanda]] to distract [[Lelaine]] and trying to manipulate her{{ref/book|12|8}}.
